Local browser dependencies: markdown-it 14.1.0 and Shiki 4.5.0 (core, Oniguruma engine, dark-plus theme, selected TextMate grammars).

Original module download URLs are recorded in sources.json. Browser shim imports were rewritten from absolute esm.sh paths to local relative paths. Licenses are included alongside the modules. These assets are excluded from the project RAG corpus by the existing vendor-directory exclusion.
